name: The Legend of Zelda™: Breath of the Wild

minimum.name: Minimum
notes: Keeps BOTW at its native Switch-class internal scale.
The source game already applies its own FXAA in docked mode, so Encore does not add another AA pass.

recommended.name: Recommandé
notes: BOTW renders at 1600x900 in docked mode on Switch.
1.5x gives approximately 2400x1350, very close to a 2560x1440 output.
Bilinear is sufficient for the small remaining scale and keeps the path light.
No extra Encore AA is layered over BOTW's own docked-mode FXAA.

high.name: Haute
notes: Bicubic scales the remaining 1800p image to 2160p without introducing an additional FSR sharpening stage.
The game remains at its original 30 FPS simulation target.

ultra.name: Ultra
notes: 3.0x produces approximately 4800x2700 internally from BOTW's 900p docked base.
This is intentional supersampling down to 4K and is therefore the quality ceiling rather than the default.
3.0x costs 9x the native pixel workload, so it is reserved for Ultra.

evidence: Nintendo: Switch version renders at 900p on TV and targets 30 FPS.
Switch mod documentation confirms an FXAA pass is applied by the game in docked mode.
